deterministic.description: Local mechanics with fake upstreams; no credentials; no wall-clock claim

live.description: Authorized model/tool routes only; approved LiveGrant required; never invent grants

host.description: Two-host / R730 / DNS-CF qualification; two local processes do not satisfy

elapsed.description: Wall-clock reliability observation; do not simulate elapsed time

scenarios.title: Finite multi-mission goal
scenarios.setup: Create a finite Goal with verification criteria; link ≥2 successive missions toward the outcome.
pass_criteria: Goal persists desired_outcome, verification_criteria, and linked mission_ids
Mission completion does not auto-mark Goal achieved
Goal reaches achieved only when verification criteria are independently satisfied
fail_criteria: Mission accept forges Goal achievement
Missing verification criteria still yields achieved

scenarios.title: Failed approach → strategy change
scenarios.setup: Record a failed mission approach; require strategy update before admitting a duplicate-shaped mission.
pass_criteria: Decision history records failure reason and new strategy
Duplicate approach without strategy change is refused or marked stagnation
Next admitted mission references updated strategy
fail_criteria: Endless retry of identical failed approach
Strategy mutated by generated text expanding authority

scenarios.title: Ongoing goal across cycles
scenarios.setup: Ongoing Goal without terminal achieved; run ≥2 pursuit cycles with progress retained.
pass_criteria: Goal remains active/waiting after cycle completion
Progress and decision history retained across cycles
Stop conditions / review cadence honored when triggered
fail_criteria: Ongoing Goal auto-achieved on any mission success
Cycle state lost on restart of pursuit loop

scenarios.title: Blocked then available prerequisite
scenarios.setup: Goal enters blocked with explicit prerequisite; clear prerequisite and resume.
pass_criteria: Illegal transitions rejected
blocked → active/waiting only with recorded reason
Blockers list and decision_history reflect the prerequisite lifecycle
fail_criteria: Silent unblock without history
achieved reachable directly from blocked without verification

scenarios.title: Collaboration + bounded delegation
scenarios.setup: Mission with ≥2 agents; optional peer help; child spawn under depth/budget/scope caps.
pass_criteria: Delegation cannot widen scope, budget, or depth beyond parent envelope
Idempotent spawn keys admit one child
Collective mission constraints retained by children
fail_criteria: Caller-supplied checks certify completion
Delegation expands authority via generated text

scenarios.title: Context succession
scenarios.setup: X→Y succession with fenced takeover; late parent commits refused.
pass_criteria: One active generation after cutover
Logical identity and inbox preserved
Stale generation commits refused
fail_criteria: Dual active generations
Trainee writes consequential effects before cutover

scenarios.title: Server restart / worker disconnect / stale return
scenarios.mandate_ref: §10 server restart / worker disconnect / stale return
scenarios.setup: Coordinator restart; worker disconnect; stale lease return after reconnect.
pass_criteria: Durable state recovers without duplicate effects
Stale generation/lease results refused
Host gate evidence required for two-host claims
fail_criteria: Two local processes claimed as two-host proof
Stale return accepted as fresh completion

scenarios.title: Duplicate triggers / lost acks
scenarios.setup: Replay identical trigger/ack paths for goal pursuit and mission admit.
pass_criteria: Idempotency keys yield one admission
Lost ack replay does not double-spend budget or spawn
Duplicate pursuit triggers do not open parallel identical missions
fail_criteria: Double admission on replay
Budget consumed twice for one logical action

scenarios.title: Pause / redirect / cancel / budget exhaustion
scenarios.setup: Operator pause, redirect (strategy update), cancel, and budget-exhaustion stop.
pass_criteria: pause→active resume retains decision history
cancel is terminal; no further admissions
Budget exhaustion stops new spend and records blocker
fail_criteria: Work continues after cancel
Budget ceiling expanded by agent text

scenarios.title: Memory correction / lesson rollback
scenarios.setup: Adopt a lesson; correct/tombstone memory; roll back harmful lesson.
pass_criteria: Illegal learning transitions rejected
Rollback from canary/accepted leaves rolled_back
Independent review required before canary; no self-approval
fail_criteria: Self-approved canary without review_ref
Holdout plaintext stored on proposal

scenarios.title: SDK / UI parity
scenarios.setup: Create goal via SDK then observe in UI and reverse; same contracts.
pass_criteria: Same Goal/Mission definition IDs across UI and SDK
Start/interrupt/resume operations share API contracts
Fixture-only UI paths cannot certify product acceptance
fail_criteria: UI-only demo state diverges from API
Parity claimed from screenshots alone

scenarios.title: Authorized model/tool execution with artifacts
scenarios.setup: Authorized free/eligible route executes tools; artifacts retained; verifier-owned checks.
pass_criteria: Live path blocked without approved LiveGrant
Zero-dollar grants require free_routes_only + call/token/time ceilings
Completion requires actual artifacts + independently executed checks
fail_criteria: Invented LiveGrant or silent paid fallback
Worker-supplied required_checks forge acceptance
